newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil coffee auction sees moderate demand so far.
newsitem.headline: Brazil coffee auction sees moderate demand so far.

text.p: An auction of 326,188 60-kg bags of Brazilian government coffee stocks was seeing only moderate demand, with 75,000 bags sold of a total offered so far of just over 269,000 bags, said an official at Banco do Brasil.
Final prices were mainly around opening prices set prior to the auction, he added.
The auction began at 1400 local/1700 GMT. The first 300,273 bags are on offer to exporters, the domestic roasting and the soluble industry. The remainder is only for the soluble industry.
Once all 36 lots have been put on offer, there is a second run-through to allow participants to buy coffee not purchased first time around.
